name: Vercel Sandbox
description: Ephemeral Firecracker microVMs on Vercel, one per sandbox.
descriptionZh: Vercel 上的临时 Firecracker microVM，每个沙箱一个。
keyFact: Vercel Sandbox gives each sandbox its own Firecracker microVM with a dedicated kernel, filesystem and network, starting in milliseconds; it runs on the same Hive infrastructure that powers Vercel's 2M+ daily builds and defaults to a 5-minute timeout with Active CPU billing.
keyFactZh: Vercel Sandbox 为每个沙箱提供独立的 Firecracker microVM（专属内核、文件系统与网络），毫秒级启动；它运行在支撑 Vercel 每日 200 万+ 构建的 Hive 基础设施上，默认超时 5 分钟并按 Active CPU 计费。
caveat: Managed-only; the platform is proprietary (the @vercel/sandbox SDK is Apache-2.0).
caveatZh: 仅托管，平台为专有（@vercel/sandbox SDK 为 Apache-2.0）。
